summary_en: 3,000,000 ordinary shares cancelled effective 2026-07-31. Post-cancellation issued shares: 43,613,500.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Nack completed the cancellation of 3,000,000 ordinary shares pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act. The board approved the cancellation on 2026-07-24, effective 2026-07-31. The cancelled shares represented 6.4% of issued shares outstanding (excluding treasury) prior to cancellation. Post-cancellation, issued shares total 43,613,500.
